topic: Company updates and strategic market wins
summary_markdown:
A team update was provided detailing recent company successes, including contract signings and tenders won in Denmark, Poland, and Malaysia. Progress is noted for Belgium (tender/POC expected Q3) and Japan (Phase 1 going live end of Q1). Upcoming extensions include Adboard (Cyprus/Hungary), Phantom Billboard (New Zealand), Adani Airports (India), and Bauer (UK).

The company did not win the US tender this round but remains a priority. Strategic discussions with NTT Docomo regarding investment are progressing positively.
action_items: Continue pursuing the US market tender
Monitor progress on strategic investment discussions with NTT Docomo
